name: TRIXICORT-40
description: A potent corticosteroid used for anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive therapy.
longDescription: TRIXICORT-40 contains Triamcinolone Acetonide, a strong steroid that reduces inflammation in the body. It is used to treat a variety of conditions such as allergic disorders, skin conditions, ulcerative colitis, arthritis, lupus, psoriasis, or breathing disorders.
usage: Relief of severe inflammatory conditions, allergic disorders & arthritis.

name: ORKETRIX
description: A combination medication used in the treatment of bacterial and parasitic infections.
longDescription: ORKETRIX is a broad-spectrum antibiotic infusion effective against a wide range of aerobic, anaerobic bacteria and protozoa. It is particularly indicated for mixed intra-abdominal infections, pelvic inflammatory disease, and severe diarrhea of mixed origin.
usage: Treatment of severe bacterial and parasitic infections.

name: NOVACEF-1.5
description: Broad-spectrum antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections.
longDescription: NOVACEF-1.5 is used to treat a wide variety of bacterial infections, including severe or life-threatening forms such as meningitis. It belongs to the cephalosporin class of antibiotics.
usage: Respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, meningitis.

name: RABZE-DSR
composition: Rabeprazole Sodium (Enteric Coated) & Domperidone (Sustained Release) Capsules
description: Used for treatment of GERD and peptic ulcer disease.
longDescription: RABZE-DSR is a combination of a proton pump inhibitor and a prokinetic agent. It decreases the amount of acid produced in the stomach and improves motility of the stomach and intestines.

name: NOVACET-P
description: Analgesic and antipyretic for pediatric use.
longDescription: NOVACET-P is an effective pain reliever and fever reducer specifically formulated for children. It acts centrally on the brain to elevate the pain threshold and reduce fever.
usage: Relief from fever and mild to moderate pain.

name: NOVAVIT PLUS
longDescription: NOVAVIT PLUS provides essential vitamins and minerals required for the healthy growth and development of children and as a restorative tonic for adults of all ages.
usage: Dietary supplement for general debility and convalescence.
